clinician.trajectory_summary: A 22-year-old man presented with dry cough, chest pain, fatigue, low grade fever, and night sweats of over 1 month duration. Initial chest X-ray showed mediastinal enlargement and left pleural effusion. Chest CT revealed a 56 × 50 mm walled cystic mass adjacent to the upper left atrium and great vessels. Surgical removal of the 5 cm cystic mass identified an echinococcal cyst containing several daughter cysts up to 10 mm. Serologic antibody testing for echinococcus was negative. Postoperatively, the patient recovered well and was treated with albendazole courses.

Postoperative clinical course was favorable with discharge and albendazole treatment.
